## 2026 State of the Ecosystem Request tracking memo: Highest priority requests

```{r}
requests |>
dplyr::filter(!Status %in% c("Done", "Not feasible"),
              Status != "",
              Status != "Removed",
              Priority == "Highest") |>
  dplyr::group_by(Category) |>
  dplyr::mutate(n = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::arrange(n) |>
  dplyr::arrange(n, Category, desc(Priority)) |>
  dplyr::select(-n) |>
  create_table(widths = c(4.5, ret_widths(3)), cap = "")
```
